title_zh: v139 深度分辨三维射线一致性容量诊断

representation.parent: the complete v138 geometry-faithful ray-overlap basis
representation.volume_message: signed K1 residual vectors are splatted along reported rays; leave-one-camera-out consensus, agreement, normalized disagreement, and visibility are retained per voxel
representation.depth_readout: fixed P1 odd and P2 even depth moments are read back along each target ray
representation.limitation: a fixed pair of low-order depth moments still compresses multimodal depth support and peer-baseline identity in five-camera cases

mechanism_diagnosis.diagnosis: Depth-resolved cross-view consensus removes every seven-, nine-, and twelve-camera cell failure and halves the five-camera failure set. The unresolved tail is now exclusively five-camera and is concentrated in p45/p58, indicating that fixed low-order depth moments still erase target-ray depth hypotheses and peer-baseline identity where angular redundancy is weakest.

audit_note.discarded_formal_attempt: An initial formal attempt used a hand-copied camera-mask digest that did not match the sealed input and was discarded; the complete formal experiment was rerun after the input seal was repaired.
audit_note.inconclusive_independent_attempt: A prior independent run reproduced every scientific metric, discrete selection, gate, count, and failure stratum but stopped because one legacy tolerance conflated physical outputs with non-unique coefficients and representation diagnostics.
audit_note.final_action: Typed numerical-equivalence tolerances were frozen before a fresh full recomputation. Scientific metrics remained at 1e-9 absolute tolerance, trajectory summaries at 1e-10, and every science-changing discrete result required exact equality.

next_gate_zh: 关闭 v139 的固定 P1/P2 深度矩表示。下一门是面向 5 相机的 target-ray 条件多假设深度代价体：沿目标射线保留固定深度 bins，把 peer residual 的符号一致性、冲突与三角测量角/基线分层保留下来，而不是压成两个低阶矩。它仍须只读部署可见 residual 与报告几何、对相机换序等变、支持 5/7/9/12 相机，并在同一 2A+2A^T 壳中先过 3700/3700、5/5 与便宜控制门。
next_gate_en: Close the fixed P1/P2 depth-moment representation. The next gate is a five-camera-focused, target-ray-conditioned multi-hypothesis depth cost volume: retain fixed depth bins and preserve peer-residual sign agreement, conflict, and triangulation-angle or baseline strata instead of compressing them into two low-order moments. It must still use only deployment-visible residuals and reported geometry, remain camera-permutation equivariant, support 5/7/9/12 cameras, and pass 3700/3700 cells, 5/5 complete trajectories, and cheap controls inside the same 2A+2A^T shell before predictor training.
